rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately grabbing, catching, or holding onto someone or something.

example.jyutping: faai3 di1 zuk3 zyu6 zek3 gau2

rows.note: Use this for authorities taking possession of goods or property under legal or official powers.

example.english: Customs seize a shipment of counterfeit goods.
example.traditional: 海關檢取咗一批冒牌貨。
example.jyutping: hoi2 gwaan1 gim2 ceoi2 zo2 jat1 pai1 mou6 paai4 fo3

rows.note: Use this when a machine or mechanism becomes jammed and cannot move or operate.

example.english: The lift may seize up without warning.
example.jyutping: bou6 sing1 gong3 gei1 kaa1 zyu6 zo2

rows.note: Use this in the formal sense of something having a sudden, powerful emotional effect on people.

example.english: This film can seize the audience with its emotional power.
example.traditional: 呢套戲深深咁撼動觀眾。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 sam1 sam1 gam3 ham6 dung6 gun1 zung3
